india6.description: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, K. C. Venugopal, Deepender Hooda, Amrinder Singh Raja Warring, have been detained and taken into custody after they started a sit-in protest inside Akashvani Bhawan to meet CEC Gyanesh Kumar

india6.title: Not a single traitor will be spared: Rahul after his forcible removal from sit-in, detention
india6.description: Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge said Mr. Gandhi was peacefully sitting on a dharna, demanding a meeting with the Election Commission (EC) and asserted that registering a peaceful protest is his constitutional right

india6.title: Minister lauds Sankar Foundation’s eye-care services
Minister inspects Bheemunipatnam-Narsipatnam road widening works
ASHA workers seek ₹15,000 monthly remuneration
india6.description: Accredited Social Health Activists affiliated to the All India United Trade Union Centre staged a protest in front of the Zilla Panchayat Chief Executive Officer’s office in Karwar on Tuesday as part of a State-wide protest week, demanding a minimum monthly remuneration of ₹15,000 and timely payment

india6.title: Students should solve their issues with V-Cs through talks, says Keralam Governor
india6.description: DLitt degree presented to filmmaker Sathyan Anthikad and industrialist P.K. Ahammed. DSc degree presented to scientist E.D. Jemmis

india6.title: Karnataka to have dedicated single-window interface to promote international tech partnerships
india6.description: Karnataka focused on building sustained relationships rather than pursuing individual investment transactions, says Priyank Kharge

india6.title: MP youth delegation concludes Karnataka visit under Yuva Sangam Phase VII

india7.title: ECI cites protocol after Rahul-led delegation seeks meeting at Parliament Annexe
india7.description: Opposition MPs, led by Rahul Gandhi, were denied a meeting with the Election Commission as their requested venue, Parliament House Annexe, contravened established protocol. The commission offered to send an officer to receive their memorandum instead.

india7.title: 11 Indians injured after vessel hit by projectile near Strait of Hormuz
india7.description: Eleven Indian crew members were injured when a vessel was struck by a projectile transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

india7.title: Two Saudi airports targeted as hostility with Yemen's Houthis escalates
india7.description: Two Saudi airports, Jazan and Najran, were attacked, injuring three and causing minor damage, escalating hostilities with Yemen's Houthis.

india7.title: India restricts ethanol production from sugarcane as sugar output declines
india7.description: To boost domestic sugar, India will restrict sugarcane juice, syrup, and B-heavy molasses for ethanol from 2026-27, ensuring more for sugar production.

india7.title: Nobel Physics Prize goes to Francis Halzen for discovery of astrophysical neutrinos
india7.description: Francis Halzen received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his significant contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and discovering high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

india7.title: BJP hits back at Opposition's EC march, dubs it bid to 'relaunch Rahul Gandhi'
india7.description: The INDIA bloc MPs marched to the Election Commission demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar.

india7.title: Rahul, Priyanka, and other Congress leaders released by Delhi Police after detention
india7.description: Congress leaders, including Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, were detained after an eight-hour sit-in protest at Akashwani Bhawan, demanding access to the Election Commission. They alleged ‘vote chori’ and treason by the Prime Minister and others, before being released late on Tuesday.

india7.title: ‘Modified Form 6 not approved by us’: SC contradicts EC’s SIR claim
india7.description: The Supreme Court clarified it did not approve any modifications to voter registration Form 6, which has an added declaration potentially hindering new voters.

india7.title: Kottayam-based notebook maker Carnet Books gears up for ₹13cr IPO
india7.description: Kottayam-based Carnet Books is set to raise ₹13.27 crore via an IPO on the BSE SME platform to fund working capital, offering 29.29 lakh shares at ₹45 each.

india7.title: US, German scientists win Nobel medicine prize for discovery that lets light control brain cells
india7.description: American Karl Deisseroth, and Germans Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel won the 2026 Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine for discovering light-gated ion channels and optogenetics, revolutionising brain research.

japan1.title: 米就業者 市場予想に反し減少 利上げ観測後退で円高ドル安進む

japan1.title: シャープ イラン情勢と円安で業績予想を下方修正
